title: Customer Identity Verification
content: Customers must complete applicable identity and address verification procedures before accessing services that require KYC compliance. The bank may request valid identity, address, and other supporting documents.

title: Protection of Authentication Credentials
content: Customers must keep passwords, PINs, CVVs, OTPs, and other authentication credentials confidential. Bank representatives will not ask customers to disclose authentication credentials through unsolicited calls, messages, or emails.

title: Reporting Unauthorized Transactions
content: Customers should report unauthorized or suspicious transactions immediately through official bank channels. The bank may request transaction details and supporting information while investigating a reported incident.

title: Protection of Customer Information
content: Customer information should be accessed and processed only for authorized banking purposes. Personal and financial information must not be disclosed to unauthorized individuals.

title: Closing a Bank Account
content: Customers requesting account closure must submit the required closure request through an authorized banking channel. Outstanding dues, pending transactions, and linked services may need to be resolved before closure.

title: Loan Repayment
content: Borrowers must make scheduled loan repayments according to the repayment schedule. Delayed payments may result in applicable charges and may affect the customer's credit profile.

title: Lost or Stolen Card
content: Customers should report lost or stolen cards immediately and request that the affected card be blocked. A replacement card may be issued after completing the required verification.

title: Transaction Disputes
content: Customers may raise disputes for eligible transactions through authorized banking channels. The bank may require transaction references and supporting details to investigate the dispute.

title: Authorized Account Access
content: Customer account information may be accessed only after appropriate authentication and authorization. Sensitive financial information must not be disclosed to unauthorized persons.

title: Bank Communication Channels
content: Customers should use official banking applications, websites, branches, and verified customer support channels for sensitive banking requests. Customers should avoid sharing confidential information through unverified communication channels.
